Vocational & Safety Studies

Academic Programs & Offerings

Providing industry-aligned vocational certifications, corporate safety standards training, and hotel management protocols.

Featured Programs

Vocational Degree 3 Years

B.Voc in Fire & Safety Management

  • Focus areas: Industrial Safety, Fire Prevention, Hazard Analysis.
  • Advanced streams: Emergency Rescue, chemical safety codes, building designs.
  • Includes physical drills, mock rescue ops, and factory visits.
Careers: Fire Officer, Safety Auditor, HSE Manager.
Vocational Degree 3 Years

B.Voc in Hotel Management & Catering

  • Focus areas: Food Production, Front Office, Housekeeping, Catering.
  • Advanced streams: Tourism Planning, Hospitality Accounting, Event Operations.
  • Includes dedicated mock kitchen and counter practice drills.
Careers: Hotel Manager, Catering Supervisor, Executive Chef.
Vocational Degree 3 Years

B.Voc in Risk & Safety Management

  • Focus areas: Hazard Control, Risk Assessment, Disaster Management.
  • Advanced streams: Environmental safety audits, industrial hygiene.
Careers: Risk Assessor, Disaster Control Officer, Plant Inspector.
Vocational Degree 3 Years

B.Voc in Agriculture & Veterinary Science

  • Focus areas: Crop Management, Soil Diagnostics, Dairy Technology.
  • Advanced streams: Horticulture, Animal Husbandry, Veterinary care.
Careers: Farm Manager, Veterinary Technician, Soil Consultant.
PG Degree 2 Years

M.Voc (Vocational Specializations)

  • Focus areas: Advanced industrial operations, corporate safety policies.
  • Focuses on corporate safety coordinates and safety audit controls.
Careers: Senior HSE Inspector, Hotel Director, Operations Head.
Diploma 1 or 2 Years

Diploma in Fire & Safety Management

  • Focus areas: Basic Firefighting tools, industrial hazard indicators.
  • Designed as a fast-track safety technician entry course.
Careers: Safety Supervisor, Fire Technician, Safety Officer.
Diploma 1 Year

Diploma in Hotel Management & Catering

  • Focus areas: Basic cooking, guest relations, laundry systems.
  • Designed as a quick service-sector certification program.
Careers: Front Desk Agent, Guest Relations, Kitchen Assistant.
